items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I mean Sarah Vaughan did all kinds of stuff.

ctx.x: You know, I think I’m getting that right. I mean Sarah Vaughan did all kinds of stuff. I mean everybody sings The Beatles. Everybody. I mean everybody has been just changing the definition of what that means. It’s less about the choice of your song now and more about how you interpret it.

Well that’s a good answer. When you go out to do a show does it matter — that’s not really the right word — if you know that your show is going to be in a club with a maximum capacity of 125 as opposed to a 2500 theater that you hope to fill, does it change your choice of material?
